AVOID: a different person or face, a changed pose or background, revealing or inappropriate clothing, added text, captions, logos, watermarks, borders, extra limbs, warped hands, duplicated people, a changed crop. NO STUDIO GEAR IN THE FRAME: no softboxes, light stands, umbrellas, reflectors, lamps, C-stands, backdrop stands or any photographic equipment may be drawn into the picture — light itself is welcome, the equipment that makes it never is.
TASK GUARD: return exactly one finished photograph and nothing else — no text, no captions, no UI, no watermark; keep the original aspect ratio and resolution feel.
